title: Other Ways to Say "Get Well Soon" in English #shorts
description:
Other ways to say "get well soon" in English. Your friend just slipped on a banana peel. Don't just say "get well soon".
• Feel better soon (everyday)
• Hope you're back on your feet soon (warm; back on your feet = healthy and active again)
• Wishing you a speedy recovery (formal: for cards, emails and work)

What would you say to your friend?
